target.section: API: role keys on member, invite and user writes (US-004, US-005) — Schema bullet

action.newText: Schema: ProjectInvite.roleId String? with assignedRole Role? @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull), and invites ProjectInvite[] on Role. Retain ProjectInvite.role as String? (nullable). Migration: apps/api/prisma/migrations/20261101090000_invite_role_id/migration.sql. A new invite stores roleId and stores role only when its key is project-admin, developer or viewer (the legacy enum the key maps to), else null. Repository includes and mapping use assignedRole; HTTP fields remain unchanged.

rationale: This resolves an impossible duplicate field declaration without changing any acceptance behavior, FK semantics, legacy fallback or migration scope.

action.text: Provide the US-005 report directly in your final reply, including TDD evidence and the Fix round 1 and Fix round 2 sections. State that report.md was not created because write permission was denied. Do not retry the denied write or use another path to bypass it. Include actual commands, observed results, and unresolved issues; do not claim unrun tests passed. Continue to review with this inline evidence.

rationale: Accepting inline reporting resolves the artifact-delivery blocker without overriding the user's repeated write denial. This does not approve the implementation, waive tests, or resolve any substantive findings.

action.text: Follow D-2: do not retry the denied report.md write or bypass the denial. Deliver the report inline, explicitly stating that red-phase evidence was not captured and is unrecoverable, alongside any verified test results. Carry the missing evidence as an unresolved review finding; do not fabricate it or claim TDD compliance. Continue to review without the report artifact; this ruling does not authorize additional writes or approve a commit.

rationale: The reporting blocker already has an approved inline alternative. Creating a file cannot recover missing evidence, and repeated write denial must remain respected. This resolves artifact delivery only, not substantive findings or test requirements.

rulingTitle: TDD evidence for AC-1 through AC-12 is absent from the review material: reading report.md returned ENOENT, and the referenced alternative reply was not supplied. The scoped command passed all 91 tests, including every AC, but this does not establish the required TDD evidence.

Passing tests do not prove TDD chronology. Do not manufacture failing runs or recreate the denied artifact. This deferral neither waives TDD requirements nor approves the implementation.
